name: Grateful Dead x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Yellow Bear'
story_html: Developed in collaboration with the iconic San Francisco jam band, the Grateful Dead x Nike Dunk Low SB ‘Yellow Bear’ features a unique design inspired by the back cover of ‘History of the Grateful Dead, Volume One (Bear’s Choice),’ a live album originally released in 1973. A vibrant yellow finish is applied to the furry upper, fortified with tonal suede overlays and mounted atop a matching yellow foam midsole. Contrasting blue hits appear on the jagged Swoosh, rubber outsole and tongue, the latter furnished with a hidden stash pocket.
